summary.tldr: Bans most promotion of fossil fuels and sets rules, exceptions, reporting duties and penalties for producers and retailers.
what_it_does: Prohibits promoting fossil fuels, fossil fuel brand elements, or fossil fuel production unless the Act or regulations allow it.
Bans promotions that are false, misleading or deceptive, including claims that fossil fuels are less harmful or bring positive effects for health, the environment, reconciliation or the economy.
Forbids sales promotions such as gifts, rebates, contests or free fossil fuel offers from producers and retailers.
Allows only limited exceptions, including point-of-sale signs showing availability and price, some works and commentary, and the use of an entity's own name.
Requires fossil fuel producers to report promotion information to the Minister of Health and lets the federal cabinet make further rules.
Creates offences and fines, and allows provinces to seek equivalency agreements if they have equivalent rules.
summary.background: The bill says it responds to a public health and environmental problem and aims to stop people from being misled about the health and environmental hazards of fossil fuels.
